cards.title: while repeats while a condition holds
cards.body: A `while` loop checks its condition, runs the body, then checks again. It stops as soon as the condition is False.
cards.code:
n = 1
while n <= 3:
    print(n)
    n = n + 1

cards.title: Change the variable, or loop forever
cards.body: If nothing in the body changes the condition, the loop never ends. `n -= 2` is a short way to write `n = n - 2`.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: The loop stops when n > 0 is first False, at 0. The print is not indented, so it runs once, after the loop.

exercise.prompt: Read N and count down from N to 1, one number per line, then print `Liftoff!`. Use a `while` loop.
exercise.starterCode:
n = int(input())
# count down with a while loop
print("Liftoff!")
